# verify.yml
# Automatic host-compile check on every push/PR. No manual trigger.
# AetherEngine-iOS · Clean-room.

name: Verify C Sources

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  compile-c-sources:
    name: Compile all C sources (host)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify repo structure
        run: |
          for f in \
            engine/core/AetherCore.c \
            engine/core/AetherEngine.c \
            engine/core/AetherMath.c \
            engine/core/AetherArray.c \
            engine/core/AetherEvent.c \
            engine/game/AetherGameManager.c \
            engine/game/AetherManifest.c \
            engine/input/AetherInput.c \
            engine/input/AetherTouch.c \
            engine/config/AetherSettings.c \
            engine/fs/AetherFS.c \
            engine/fs/AetherPak.c \
            engine/audio/AetherAudio.c \
            engine/render/AetherRender.c \
            engine/bsp/AetherBSP.c \
            engine/bsp/AetherBSPGeometry.c \
          ; do
            [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "MISSING: $f"; exit 1; }
            echo "OK: $f"
          done

      - name: Compile every C file (strict)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/obj
          FAIL=0
          for f in \
            engine/core/AetherCore.c \
            engine/core/AetherEngine.c \
            engine/core/AetherMath.c \
            engine/core/AetherArray.c \
            engine/core/AetherEvent.c \
            engine/game/AetherGameManager.c \
            engine/game/AetherManifest.c \
            engine/input/AetherInput.c \
            engine/input/AetherTouch.c \
            engine/config/AetherSettings.c \
            engine/fs/AetherFS.c \
            engine/fs/AetherPak.c \
            engine/audio/AetherAudio.c \
            engine/render/AetherRender.c \
            engine/bsp/AetherBSP.c \
            engine/bsp/AetherBSPGeometry.c \
          ; do
            echo "→ cc -c $f"
            cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter \
              -Iengine/core -Iengine/game -Iengine/input -Iengine/config \
              -Iengine/fs -Iengine/audio -Iengine/render -Iengine/bsp \
              -c "$f" -o "/tmp/obj/$(basename "$f" .c).o" || FAIL=1
          done
          [ "$FAIL" -ne 0 ] && { echo "❌ Compile errors"; exit 1; }
          echo "✅ All C sources compile cleanly"

      - name: Verify manifests present
        run: |
          for m in valve bshift gearbox cstrike czero; do
            [ -f "engine/game/manifests/$m.json" ] || { echo "MISSING: $m.json"; exit 1; }
            echo "OK: $m.json"
          done

      - name: Verify Swift sources present
        run: |
          for s in \
            AetherApp.swift DashboardView.swift SettingsView.swift \
            TouchControlsView.swift EngineBridge.c EngineBridge.h \
            AetherAudioiOS.swift MetalRenderer.swift MetalCallbacks.swift \
            Shaders.metal Bridging-Header.h \
          ; do
            [ -f "ios/AetherApp/$s" ] && echo "OK: $s" || echo "MISSING: $s"
          done
